item.title: Shakespeare Dallas hosts pub crawl with live performances
item.description: Shakespeare Dallas is hosting its annual pub crawl in the Bishop Arts District on Saturday, March 7, 2026, featuring live performances, contests, and drink specials at multiple neighborhood bars, with tickets available for purchase online.

item.title: Jason Kidd boosts girls' basketball opportunities in D-FW
item.description: Jason Kidd has launched Kidd Select South, a North Texas-based program for elite female basketball athletes, in partnership with True Texas Hoops and supported by the Kidd Foundation, to provide opportunities for young female athletes to succeed.

item.title: Discover the 1920s glamour of 'The Great Gatsby' with Broadway Dallas
item.description: 'The Great Gatsby' brings F. Scott Fitzgerald's classic novel to life in a lavish production of love, wealth and tragedy, and is playing at the Music Hall at Fair Park until March 1, 2026.

item.title: Raising Cane's gives $30K to Cody's Friends Rescue for dogs
item.description: Raising Cane's donated over $30,000 to Cody's Friends Rescue following a successful holiday fundraising campaign.

item.title: Dallas PULSE faces Indy Ignite at Comerica Center
item.description: The Dallas PULSE will host Indy Ignite on Feb. 19, in a matchup between the top two teams in Major League Volleyball, with a buy-one, get-one free ticket promotion available until 5:00 p.m. today.

item.title: Chick-fil-A offers free chicken biscuits nationwide
item.description: Chick-fil-A is offering free chicken biscuits to customers in the Dallas-Fort Worth area from Feb. 17-28, and will launch its Cow Billboard Cup on Feb. 23, with a limited number of customers receiving a Golden Cup design for free Chick-fil-A for one year.

item.title: Texas home sales lag behind national average, study shows
item.description: Rhode Island has the fastest home selling rate in the country, while Texas ranks among the slowest, with homeowners waiting an average of 65 days to close a deal, according to a new study from CabinetSelect.

item.title: Turbotax, Uber offer free Dallas rides for tax filers
item.description: TurboTax and Uber have partnered to provide free rides for people filing their taxes at new office locations in Dallas, with a ride credit of up to $25.

item.title: These Texas industries top the list for workplace dangers
item.description: A study identified the most hazardous industries for Texans based on non-fatal injury rates across different sectors.

item.title: Chef Sarabjit Singh Assi to host Holi dinner in NYC for James Beard Foundation
item.description: Sanjh Restaurant & Bar's executive chef has been invited to participate in a James Beard Foundation collaborative dinner in New York City to help host a Holi Dinner.
